scope_note: This identifies the 1953 Strachey Standard Edition manifestation used by many English citations and prevents volume IV or V alone from masquerading as the complete translation.
statement: James Strachey's 1953 Standard Edition translation of The Interpretation of Dreams is divided between volumes IV and V.
statement_zh: James Strachey 於 1953 年編譯的 Standard Edition《夢的解析》分置於第四與第五卷。
